description: Protects group IT, OT and cloud estates; runs monitoring, identity, vulnerability and incident response.

name: Finance

name: Procurement
description: Strategic sourcing, supplier management, purchase-to-pay and spend analytics for production and indirect material.

name: Sales & Aftersales
description: Dealer network, order-to-delivery, customer data, fleet service and connected-truck data.

name: Human Resources (shared function)
description: Employee master data and lifecycle; feeds identity and finance systems. Not a focus domain but a key upstream dependency.
